reader_summary.headline: David Schneider discusses scaling ServiceNow, Data Domain, and his move to Coatue.
reader_summary.overview: David Schneider co-leads Coatue's Growth Fund after previously scaling ServiceNow from $100M to $5B in revenue. He also helped grow Data Domain from zero customers to over $1B. The episode covers his career lessons, leadership changes, and the transition from operator to investor.
